sample_size.excerpt: In total, 515 RCC cases (International Classification for Oncology 3: C64.9) and 4144 subcohort members were included in the analyses. Of the 384 included RCC cases with confirmed tumor histology 315 (82.0%) were ccRCC cases and 46 (12.0%) were pRCC cases.
